findings.title: The package has no abstract
findings.attack: An abstract is required in all three offices (37 CFR 1.72(b); Art. 78(1)(e) and Rule 47 EPC; s.14(2)(d) PA 1977). None is in the package, so question 12 cannot be answered and an abstract drafted later would be unreviewed text.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Draft an abstract of not more than 150 words summarising claims 1, 2 and 3 in the locked terms, with reference signs and no 'means for' language, and check it against question 12 before Gate 3.

findings.title: No drawing sheets exist; only figure instructions
findings.attack: The description relies on FIGS. 1-13B but only a figure plan and instructions exist. Late-filed drawings risk missing-parts treatment (Rule 56 EPC; s.15(5) PA 1977) and new matter in the US; drawing formalities (Rule 46 EPC; 37 CFR 1.84; r.14 PR 2007) cannot be checked.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Render drawing sheets from the figure instructions, check every numeral against registry.md, file them with the description, and remove the candidate/unconfirmed wording from the captions once the inventor has decided on those constructions.

gate14.evidence: Depends on commercial facts not in the package. Claim 1 valve core (replacement unit, [0161]); claim 3 seat ring (replacement part, [0162]); claim 47 tyre valve; claim 2 method; claim 4 manufacture. Validity of claims 1 and 3 contested (F-32-1, F-32-2).

Adverse. [0179]-[0180] axial disc-spring deflection escapes 'radially deflectable element' and 'radial expansion' (F-33-1); contact from lift-off escapes 'spaced ... throughout the normal stroke' (F-33-2).
Disc spring of [0179] has no drawing or claim (F-36-5); FIGS. 11A-11C, 12A-12B, 13A captioned as not stated in the inventor's disclosure yet claimed in claims 26, 40-44, 66, 67 (F-32-4, F-36-1).

'closed at rest and throughout the normal stroke' has no limiting content (F-32-3); unconfirmed constructions claimed (F-32-4); axial load path inconsistent (F-28-1); detent not disclosed in combination (F-29-2).
Claims 5-12, 20-29, 33-34, 68-69; nested narrower ranges containing the prototype value [0240]-[0248]. No fallback cures the evidential gap of F-32-1.

Principal embodiment enabled ([0230]-[0250], [0279]-[0281]); ranges untested ([0230]); PEEK seat ring gives no purge gap value ([0290]); two-piece seat has no dimensions ([0293]). F-32-9, F-32-10, F-36-8.
Broad, two narrower ranges and prototype value for each parameter ([0231]-[0249]); normal stroke has no range ([0235], F-36-6).
Device claims 1, 77; replacement seat ring claim 3; system claims 47-50; use claims 2, 51-61; manufacture claims 4, 78-86; no software or control aspect disclosed.

Depends on commercial facts not in the package. Internal structure shown by teardown and bench test; over-travel audible ([0288]). Manufacture claim 4 not detectable (F-35-1); claim 2 performed by end users (F-33-3).
No priority document supplied (Prompt 31). Design-around candidates separated only by captions in figures.md and registry.md, not in the description (F-28-2, F-32-4).
Thermal variant [0296] (no data), two-piece seat [0293]-[0295] (no dimensions), disc spring [0179] disclosed but unclaimed; later claims to them face F-36-8.
Prompt 40a corrections not applied: conjunctive multiple dependencies, e.g. claim 13 (F-40a-1); FIG. 13A missing from [0036]-[0049] (F-40a-2); no drawing sheets (F-gate14-2).
The package records no review by counsel; cannot be answered on counsel's behalf.

assumptions.text: A1. The package is the whole application as it would be filed; no abstract, drawing sheets or priority document exist elsewhere.
A2. Questions 1 and 9 are answered from the package text only; commercial facts are not known.
A3. Question 2 'yes' is the adverse answer.
A4. Question 13 is 'no' because the formal pass found defects not applied to this package.
A5. Treated as a first filing because no priority document is supplied.

open_questions.text: Q1. Is priority to be claimed from any earlier filing? Supply it under intake/priority/.
Q2. Which candidate constructions of FIGS. 11A-11C, 12A-12B and 13A has the inventor conceived?
Q3. What product will be sold first, and to whom?
Q4. Will the thermal variant or the two-piece seat be pursued later? If so, supply operative values before the first filing.
Q5. Counsel's review of jurisdiction-specific requirements is for the human to arrange.
